MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The adhesive bar magnets felt like a natural next choice because they offer another practical way to mount things alongside my magnetic hooks.",
    "The small magnets connected with my recent interest in magnets, although that interest alone would not make me buy a large pack without a specific use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The fishing magnet shares a material with my hooks, but retrieving objects from a river is a different purpose from mounting things at home or in a workspace.",
    "The electrical connectors and heat shrink tubing require a wiring project I do not currently have; buying nuts, bolts and washers does not imply that need.",
    "The test kit, bulk gloves and grinding discs do not address a current need suggested by my recent purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in magnetic hooks seemed to be stretched into interest in magnets of any size or purpose.",
    "My fastener purchases seemed to be treated as interest in a broad range of repair supplies, even when they serve unrelated tasks."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The practical attachment function of my hooks matters more to me than simply finding another product containing magnets.",
    "Size, quantity and an immediate use matter: tiny magnets or a full roll of tubing are not appealing just because they might someday be useful.",
    "I rarely act on recommendations unless they fit a concrete need, so a loose connection to hardware is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in practical mounting supplies but extended it too broadly into unrelated magnets and repair tasks."
}
